pillars.label: Outreach
pillars.title: Meeting Needs in the Field
pillars.description: Our outreach programs directly serve unsheltered individuals across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex — putting resources in the hands of those who need them most.

programs.name: SERVE
programs.description: Each Spring, we prepare and deliver warm meals to various homeless communities across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex.

programs.name: THIRST
programs.description: During the summer, we distribute water and hydration supplies to various homeless communities throughout the DFW area.

programs.name: Coats & Cocoa
programs.description: Every winter, we distribute coats, blankets, socks, hats, scarves, and gloves along with hot beverages to unsheltered communities across DFW.

pillars.label: Education
pillars.title: Raising Awareness & Building Knowledge
pillars.description: Education drives empathy and action. Our programs work to inform the public, reduce stigma, and build the leadership capacity needed to address systemic homelessness.

programs.name: IRAdicating Homelessness
programs.description: An ongoing social media campaign designed to increase public education about homelessness, promote policy advocacy for affordable housing, and decrease stigma surrounding unhoused individuals.

programs.name: REST Leadership Retreat
programs.description: An annual collaboration bringing together nonprofit and small business leaders from across DFW to develop knowledge, skills, and partnerships that advance collective missions and strengthen communities.

pillars.label: Advocacy
pillars.title: Driving Systemic Change
pillars.description: We believe lasting change requires changing the systems that perpetuate homelessness. Our advocacy pillar is growing.

programs.name: Advocacy Programming
programs.description: This area of our work is expanding. Stay connected through our newsletter for updates on how you can raise your voice to help end homelessness in DFW.
